# Fushi Codex Pet

Fushi is an anime-style sea slug Codex pet.

## Install

Copy the `fushi` folder into your Codex pets directory:

```text
%USERPROFILE%\.codex\pets\fushi
```

The folder must contain:

```text
fushi/
  pet.json
  spritesheet.webp
```

Restart Codex, then choose Fushi from Settings > Appearance > Avatar.
